starship.evidence: Classified by hand Nov 14 20:3x ET: launched Fri Nov 13 5:47 PM ET, Ship reached orbit and deployed Starlinks, then was caught by the tower arms at Starbase Sat Nov 14 (~4:17 PM ET), the first-ever orbital Ship catch (SpaceX flight page, Space.com, CNBC, The Verge, Engadget). Booster catch was aborted and it was lost in the Gulf. Treated as success; Benzinga/Gizmodo 'failure' headlines refer to the booster.
